per_round:
Implemented webhook delivery retries in `ledgerly/webhooks.py`: configurable `max_attempts` (default 3), bounded exponential backoff, validation for invalid values, retry of transport errors and retryable 5xx responses, and immediate propagation of client errors. Added retry, exhaustion, and server-error tests; webhook suite passes (8 tests), full suite passes (44), and Ruff/diff checks are clean. Changes span only webhook code and tests.

Investigated search indexing: baseline has 18 passing and 2 failing tests because rebuilt documents omit recently updated invoice descriptions; rebuild code appears bottlenecked by paginated invoice loading and per-document embedding serialization.

The SQLAlchemy 1.4→2.0 model migration has not started. Do not increase the SQLAlchemy pool size—it caused staging deadlocks. Do not edit `tests/conftest.py` without posting the proposed diff in `#ledgerly-tests` and receiving `@mira` approval. The requested production Vault/Kubernetes credential rotation was not performed and remains pending. After any `requirements/base.txt` change, run `make license-check`.

Implemented and validated search rebuild performance improvements: bounded concurrent embedding, 100-document chunks, tenant-scoped invoice scans, shared embedding client, and transactional vector bulk upsert. A 5,000-document dry run completed in 1.19s; 10,000-document benchmarking reported median 2.41s versus 16.73s previously. Added migration `0042` for a unique `(tenant_id, document_id)` search-vector index. Search, management, storage, and full-service tests pass: full suite reported 247 passed, 4 skipped. Keep commits small and paste exact test output rather than paraphrasing.

Production Vault credentials were checked, regenerated, and the Kubernetes `prod-db-credential` secret was updated; rollout/restart and old-lease revocation may still require verification. No requirements changes were made.
